Why does nobody talk about how weird it is to run into your coworkers outside of work? Like, I saw my boss at the grocery store last Saturday and we both just froze. It was so awkward! What do you even say? We stood there in the produce section making small talk about avocados for like five minutes. Avocados! I don't even like avocados that much! And then you do that thing where you say "well, see you Monday!" and then you keep bumping into them in every aisle. So you just pretend to be really interested in whatever's on the shelf. Oh, is that a can of chickpeas? How fascinating! I've also run into my dentist at a restaurant once. He looked at my plate and I swear he was mentally judging my dessert. Maybe I'm overthinking this. Probably. Definitely. But can we all just agree that there should be some kind of unspoken rule about pretending you didn't see each other? That would make everyone's life so much easier!
